regularization_application_rule: Anti-collapse pressure must include a named encoder or projector representation; predictor-output-only regularization invalidates the condition.

diagnostics.definition: Population variance of each named representation dimension over the registered diagnostic batch.
diagnostics.collapse_signal: many dimensions approach a preregistered training-only floor

diagnostics.definition: Mean absolute off-diagonal covariance plus the complete covariance-diagonal summary for the named representation.
diagnostics.collapse_signal: dimensions are redundant or covariance structure is unstable across grouped folds

diagnostics.definition: Complete reduced singular-value spectrum of the centered registered embedding matrix, with matrix shape and dtype.
diagnostics.collapse_signal: one or a few modes dominate under a preregistered sensitivity rule

diagnostics.definition: exp(-sum_i p_i log(p_i)), where p_i = sigma_i^2 / sum_j sigma_j^2 and zero-energy matrices are separately flagged.
diagnostics.collapse_signal: effective rank approaches one or is unstable across grouped folds

diagnostics.definition: Smallest rank reaching the preregistered cumulative singular-energy threshold, with threshold sensitivity recorded.
diagnostics.collapse_signal: rank is degenerate or conclusion depends on a post-hoc threshold

diagnostics.definition: Largest divided by smallest retained singular value only when the smallest value exceeds the recorded numerical floor; otherwise null with rank-deficient flag.
diagnostics.collapse_signal: extreme or nonfinite conditioning that is stable under dtype and floor sensitivity checks

diagnostics.definition: Mean Euclidean distance over a fixed seeded subset of distinct embedding pairs.
diagnostics.collapse_signal: distance approaches a preregistered training-only floor

diagnostics.definition: Rate at which each embedding's nearest eligible neighbor shares its recording-session identity, excluding the same source window and overlap-defined neighbors.
diagnostics.collapse_signal: not collapse by itself; a high rate indicates nuisance session identity and weak transfer evidence

diagnostics.definition: Detects an exactly or numerically constant registered representation using the preregistered dtype-aware floor.
Count and fraction of dimensions whose training-partition variance exceeds the preregistered floor.
diagnostics.collapse_signal: few dimensions are utilized or utilization is fold-unstable

diagnostics.definition: Objective-specific latent prediction loss with reduction, mask denominator, and target scope recorded.
diagnostics.collapse_signal: not a collapse test alone; low loss with failed geometry checks is explicitly insufficient

diagnostics.definition: Every active SIGReg, VICReg-style, reconstruction, or query-specialization component reported separately and before weighting.
diagnostics.collapse_signal: not a collapse test alone; missing or inactive expected pressure invalidates the condition

diagnostics.definition: Frozen-protocol linear-probe balanced accuracy, macro F1, Brier score, and expected calibration error on training or inner-validation groups at each epoch; the outer held-out group is evaluated once after complete condition freeze.
diagnostics.collapse_signal: chance-like or fold-unstable performance despite favorable geometry prevents a non-collapse interpretation
